structuralFindings: Rates are NOT per-room-category. A single per-person-per-night rate grid (by Season x Meal Plan) applies uniformly across every accommodation type — 1BR Penthouse Suite, 2BR Suite/Bungalow Suite, 3BR Suite/Bungalow Suite, 3BR Villa. Accommodation types differ only in max occupancy/layout, not price.
Four meal-plan tiers offered as base rate options (not supplements): Accommodation Only, Bed & Breakfast, Half-Board, Full-Board — guest picks one as the base per-person rate.

Three seasons: Low, High, Peak — note Peak season here (21 Dec - 3 Jan) is HIGHER priced than High season, which is itself higher than Low. Confirm season labels aren't confused with Soroi's Peak/Shoulder/Green naming convention — different portfolio, different label meanings.
Peak Season carries a 7-night minimum stay (vs 2-night minimum for High/Low).
Long-stay discounts apply to accommodation-only portion, NOT valid over Peak season: 25% off 8-14 nights, 30% off 15-27 nights, bespoke for 28+.
Low Season special offer: 1 night free (accommodation only) for bookings of 4-7 nights.
Children 0-3 free of charge; children defined as 4-12 years old (differs from Soroi's 5-11/12-17 brackets — do not reuse Soroi child-age logic for this property).
Meal Supplement Rates exist for adding a higher meal plan on top of a lower one, distinct from and consistent with the base-rate meal-plan table (see mealSupplements below).
